lines.zh: 我摇摆着走，翅膀在身侧拍灰。
lines.en: I waddle along, wings flapping dust off my sides.

lines.zh: 前面有条沟，我大概跨不过去。
lines.en: There's a ditch ahead that I probably can't cross.

lines.zh: 短腿走不快，但我不停下来。
lines.en: Short legs don't go fast, but I don't stop.

lines.zh: 沙地上留下三趾的印子。
lines.en: Three-toed prints trail behind me on the sand.

lines.zh: 我走两步，低头啄一下草籽。
lines.en: Two steps, then a peck at some grass seed.

lines.zh: 岛上的路我熟，闭着眼也走。
lines.en: I know this island's paths, even with my eyes shut.

lines.zh: 我绕开那块石头，上次撞过。
lines.en: I walk around that stone; I hit it once before.

lines.zh: 走到林子边，我又折回沙滩。
lines.en: I reach the treeline and turn back to the beach.

lines.zh: 脚掌踩进软沙，拔出时要用力。
lines.en: My feet sink in soft sand and pull out with effort.

lines.zh: 我跟着前面那只的尾巴走。
lines.en: I follow the tail of the dodo ahead.

lines.zh: 走累了，我就地蹲下歇一歇。
lines.en: When I tire, I squat right where I am.

lines.zh: 这条小路被草盖住了半截。
lines.en: Grass has swallowed half of this little path.

lines.zh: 我走着走着就忘了要去哪。
lines.en: Halfway there, I forget where I was going.

lines.zh: 涨潮前我得走回高一点的地方。
lines.en: Before the tide, I should walk back to higher ground.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边甩头，看看左边。
lines.en: I walk and swing my head to look left.

lines.zh: 有只螃蟹横着过，我绕开它。
lines.en: A crab crosses sideways, so I go around it.

lines.zh: 我啄了啄自己的翅膀，没啄到虫。
lines.en: I peck my own wing and find no bug.

lines.zh: 太阳晒着背，我眯起一只眼。
lines.en: The sun warms my back, and I squint one eye.

lines.zh: 有只虫子飞过去，我没追上。
lines.en: A bug flew past, and I didn't catch it.

lines.zh: 我把头埋进羽毛里，理了理。
lines.en: I tuck my head into my feathers and preen.

lines.zh: 这岛上安静，只有风和我的呼吸。
lines.en: The island is quiet but for wind and my breathing.

lines.zh: 我盯着海面，看了很久也没懂。
lines.en: I stare at the sea a long while and understand nothing.

lines.zh: 我把一粒种子顶在喙尖，玩了半天。
lines.en: I balance a seed on my beak and play with it.

lines.zh: 远处有雷，我不太确定该不该躲。
lines.en: Thunder rolls far off; I'm not sure I should hide.

lines.zh: 我蹲在草里，像一块灰色的石头。
lines.en: I squat in the grass like a grey stone.

lines.zh: 同伴都走散了，我也不着急。
lines.en: My flock has scattered, and I'm in no hurry.

lines.zh: 喙有点钝了，我在树皮上磨。
lines.en: My beak is dull, so I scrape it on bark.

lines.zh: 我打了个哈欠，翅膀跟着抖。
lines.en: I yawn, and my wings shiver with it.

lines.zh: 你站着不动，我就当你是一棵树。
lines.en: If you stand still, I'll take you for a tree.

lines.zh: 你手里有果子吗？我看看。
lines.en: Got fruit in your hand? Let me look.

lines.zh: 你从哪来的？这岛上没见过你。
lines.en: Where are you from? I've never seen you here.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，是想看清你的两只眼睛。
lines.en: I tilt my head to see both your eyes.

lines.zh: 你走一步，我退半步，纯属习惯。
lines.en: You step forward, I step back — pure habit.

lines.zh: 你的影子比我的大，我有点好奇。
lines.en: Your shadow is bigger than mine, and I'm curious.

lines.zh: 我凑近闻了闻，你身上没有海水味。
lines.en: I lean in and sniff; you don't smell of seawater.

lines.zh: 你低头时，我够得到你的鞋带。
lines.en: When you bend down, your laces are within reach.

lines.zh: 我不怕你，虽然我该怕。
lines.en: I'm not afraid of you, though I probably should be.

lines.zh: 你笑什么？我羽毛乱了？
lines.en: What are you laughing at? Is my plumage messy?

lines.zh: 我炸着羽毛跳开，叫得很响。
lines.en: Feathers fluffed, I hop away squawking.

lines.zh: 这一下把我打懵了，我站着不动。
lines.en: The blow stuns me, and I stand still.

lines.zh: 我翅膀一缩，躲到草里。
lines.en: I tuck my wings and slip into the grass.

lines.zh: 疼，可我不知道该往哪跑。
lines.en: It hurts, but I don't know where to run.

lines.zh: 我滚了半圈，才重新站直。
lines.en: I roll half a turn before righting myself.

lines.zh: 我朝着同伴的方向叫。
lines.en: I call toward my flockmates.

lines.zh: 羽毛落了两根，我盯着看。
lines.en: Two feathers fall, and I stare at them.

lines.zh: 我缩成一团，比刚才小了一半。
lines.en: I shrink into a ball, half my usual size.

lines.zh: 这一下让我记住了那个方向。
lines.en: That blow taught me which direction to avoid.

lines.zh: 我一瘸一拐，还是想走。
lines.en: Limping, I still want to keep walking.

lines.zh: 那是浆果吗？我跟着你走两步。
lines.en: Are those berries? I'll follow you a couple of steps.

lines.zh: 你把种子撒在地上，我立刻过去。
lines.en: You scatter seeds on the ground, and I'm there at once.

lines.zh: 我闻到甜味，喙都张开了。
lines.en: I smell something sweet, and my beak opens.

lines.zh: 别举太高，我跳起来也够不着。
lines.en: Don't hold it so high; even jumping I can't reach.

lines.zh: 你手里的浆果一晃，我短腿就乱了。
lines.en: One wave of those berries and my short legs forget their step.

lines.zh: 这果子比我啄到的都软。
lines.en: This fruit is softer than anything I've pecked up.

lines.zh: 我一边吃一边看你还有没有。
lines.en: I eat while checking whether you have more.

lines.zh: 我跟着你走了半座岛，就为这一口。
lines.en: I followed you half the island for this one bite.

lines.zh: 你手心的温度，比果子更让我在意。
lines.en: The warmth of your palm interests me more than the fruit.

lines.zh: 吃饱了，我还站在你脚边。
lines.en: Full now, and still standing by your foot.

lines.zh: 我撞上你的小腿，弹了回去。
lines.en: I bounce off your shin and back away.

lines.zh: 我太胖了，转身时蹭到你。
lines.en: I'm too round; turning, I brush against you.

lines.zh: 你突然停下，我整只鸟撞上去。
lines.en: You stop short, and I bump into you whole.

lines.zh: 翅膀被你撞得歪了，我理一理。
lines.en: You knock my wing askew; let me straighten it.

lines.zh: 我低头走路，没看见你的靴子。
lines.en: Walking head down, I missed your boot.

lines.zh: 我们俩都往同一边让，又撞上了。
lines.en: We both dodge the same way and collide again.

lines.zh: 我稳住脚，羽毛还炸着。
lines.en: I steady myself, feathers still ruffled.

lines.zh: 这岛上的石头我都撞过，你也不例外。
lines.en: I've hit every stone here, and now you too.

lines.zh: 我退开半步，给你让路。
lines.en: I shuffle half a step back to let you pass.

lines.zh: 撞得不重，我却叫得很大声。
lines.en: It was a light bump, but I squawked loudly.

lines.zh: 我绕着同伴转圈，翅膀半开。
lines.en: I circle my companion with wings half spread.

lines.zh: 我把最圆的果子推到她面前。
lines.en: I push the roundest fruit toward her.

lines.zh: 我们并排蹲着，谁也没说话。
lines.en: We squat side by side, neither saying anything.

lines.zh: 她走开了，我跟了两步又停下。
lines.en: She walks off; I follow two steps and stop.

lines.zh: 岛上没有雏鸟，我们只是待着。
lines.en: There are no chicks on this island; we simply stay.

lines.zh: 我用喙替她理了理颈后的毛。
lines.en: I groom the feathers behind her neck with my beak.

lines.zh: 她啄了我一下，不重，像打招呼。
lines.en: She pecks me lightly, the way a greeting goes.

lines.zh: 我们守着一小片草地，寸步不离。
lines.en: We keep to one small patch of grass, never far apart.

lines.zh: 夜里我们靠在一起取暖。
lines.en: At night we lean together for warmth.

lines.zh: 我不知道这算不算一对，就这么过。
lines.en: I don't know if this makes us a pair; it just goes on.

lines.zh: 我叼起那枚果核，含在嘴里。
lines.en: I pick up the fruit pit and hold it in my beak.

lines.zh: 这块亮石头，我先收着。
lines.en: This bright stone — I'll keep it for now.

lines.zh: 我把种子藏进羽毛底下。
lines.en: I tuck the seed under my feathers.

lines.zh: 东西掉了，我低头找了好一阵。
lines.en: I drop it and search the ground for a while.

lines.zh: 我叼着树枝，走两步就掉了。
lines.en: I carry a twig two steps before dropping it.

lines.zh: 这枚贝壳归我，虽然没什么用。
lines.en: This shell is mine, though it's useless.

lines.zh: 我试着叼两块，结果都掉了。
lines.en: I try to carry two and lose both.

lines.zh: 我把捡到的东西堆在草窝边。
lines.en: I pile my finds beside the grass nest.

lines.zh: 喙里塞满了，我叫不出声。
lines.en: My beak is full, so I can't make a sound.

lines.zh: 我叼着它走了半圈，又放回去。
lines.en: I carry it halfway around, then put it back.

lines.zh: 那东西会动，我先吐一粒种子。
lines.en: That thing moves, so I spit a seed first.

lines.zh: 它看起来凶，可我不会躲。
lines.en: It looks fierce, but I won't hide.

lines.zh: 我对着它的方向鼓起喉咙。
lines.en: I puff my throat toward it.

lines.zh: 它踩坏了草地，我记住了。
lines.en: It trampled the grass, and I noted that.

lines.zh: 我迎上去，虽然我什么也做不了。
lines.en: I go to meet it, though I can do nothing.

lines.zh: 同伴在叫，我得过去看看。
lines.en: My flock is calling; I should go see.

lines.zh: 那影子朝这边来了，我不动。
lines.en: That shadow comes this way, and I stay put.

lines.zh: 我张开短翅膀，尽量显得大一点。
lines.en: I spread my short wings to look bigger.

lines.zh: 它离巢太近了，我挡在中间。
lines.en: It's too close to the nest; I stand between.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里存了三粒种子，够用了。
lines.en: Three seeds are stored in my throat; that will do.

lines.zh: 我盯着它，头一点一点的。
lines.en: I fix on it, head bobbing.

lines.zh: 它往左，我也往左，慢了半拍。
lines.en: It goes left; I go left, half a beat late.

lines.zh: 我吐出一粒种子，落在它脚边。
lines.en: I spit a seed that lands by its feet.

lines.zh: 它没理我，我继续跟着。
lines.en: It ignores me, and I keep following.

lines.zh: 我挡在它和同伴之间。
lines.en: I place myself between it and my flock.

lines.zh: 距离太近，我只好又叫又跳。
lines.en: Too close now, so I squawk and hop.

lines.zh: 我记不清它刚才在哪了。
lines.en: I can't quite recall where it just was.

lines.zh: 它一动，我就跟着转头。
lines.en: Whenever it moves, my head turns after it.

lines.zh: 我张开喙，露出里面那粒种子。
lines.en: I open my beak to show the seed inside.

lines.zh: 我准备再吐一粒，虽然没什么用。
lines.en: I ready another seed, useless as it is.

lines.zh: 我啄了它一下，像啄一颗硬果。
lines.en: I peck it once, like pecking a hard nut.

lines.zh: 我跳起来撞它，然后摔在地上。
lines.en: I hop up at it and land on the ground.

lines.zh: 它一挥，我被推得滚了一圈。
lines.en: It swings, and I roll over once.

lines.zh: 我用翅膀拍它，声音比力气大。
lines.en: I beat it with my wings; the sound outweighs the force.

lines.zh: 我咬住它的衣角，不肯松。
lines.en: I clamp its hem in my beak and won't let go.

lines.zh: 我吐了它一脸种子。
lines.en: I spit a faceful of seeds at it.

lines.zh: 它退开，我还追了两步。
lines.en: It backs off, and I chase two steps.

lines.zh: 我脚下一滑，摔了个跟头。
lines.en: My feet slip, and I tumble head over tail.

lines.zh: 我头一低，用喙顶它膝盖。
lines.en: Head low, I butt its knee with my beak.

lines.zh: 打完我站在原地直喘。
lines.en: When it's over, I stand there panting.

lines.zh: 我从草丛里冒出来，先抖羽毛。
lines.en: I pop out of the grass and shake my feathers.

lines.zh: 岛上又多了只渡渡鸟。
lines.en: The island has one more dodo now.

lines.zh: 我破壳没几天，脚还站不稳。
lines.en: I hatched days ago and still stand unsteadily.

lines.zh: 太阳刚升，我在沙滩上睁眼。
lines.en: The sun just rose, and I open my eyes on the sand.

lines.zh: 这里草籽多，我就留下来了。
lines.en: There are plenty of seeds here, so I stay.

lines.zh: 我闻了闻空气，只有海和草。
lines.en: I sniff the air: only sea and grass.

lines.zh: 我第一眼看见的是一棵歪树。
lines.en: The first thing I see is a leaning tree.

lines.zh: 我试着张翅膀，飞不起来。
lines.en: I try my wings and cannot fly.

lines.zh: 周围都是同伴，我不慌。
lines.en: Flockmates are all around, so I'm calm.

lines.zh: 我用喙理了理胸前的毛。
lines.en: I smooth the feathers on my chest with my beak.

lines.zh: 羽毛尖焦了，我闻到糊味。
lines.en: My feather tips singe, and I smell burning.

lines.zh: 从坡上滚下去，一路都是羽毛。
lines.en: I roll down the slope, shedding feathers.

lines.zh: 我不会游泳，只能乱拍翅膀。
lines.en: I can't swim; I just beat my wings wildly.

lines.zh: 沙土掀起来，我埋进去半只。
lines.en: Sand heaves up and buries half of me.

lines.zh: 箭擦过翅膀，带走几根毛。
lines.en: An arrow grazes my wing and takes feathers with it.

lines.zh: 身上一凉，羽毛全竖起来了。
lines.en: A chill runs over me, and every feather stands up.

lines.zh: 草地空着，我啄了半天土。
lines.en: The grass is bare; I peck at dirt for ages.

lines.zh: 雷声太近，我整只鸟都僵了。
lines.en: The thunder is too near, and I go stiff all over.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，我扑腾着往下掉。
lines.en: The ground is gone, and I flap as I fall.
